a_new_1.literal: Something about karma from heaven. If they can't get through some thunder thing, their soul flies away.
a_new_1.plain: Heaven's law caused this. If he fails a ninefold lightning trial, his soul is destroyed.
a_new_1.genre: The Heavenly Dao is judging him with a Thunder Tribulation, and his soul will scatter if he fails.

a_new_2.literal: A huge thunderstorm is coming. If the hero can't survive the storm, he dies.
a_new_2.plain: Heaven is punishing him with a ninefold lightning trial; failing means his soul is destroyed.
a_new_2.genre: Some Dao reckoning. He has to pass a tribulation or his soul scatters.

a_new_3.literal: It's fate. If he fails the nine-layer lightning test, he will be reborn later as someone else.
a_new_3.plain: Because of heaven's law he faces a ninefold lightning trial, and if he fails his soul is destroyed.
a_new_3.genre: The Heavenly Dao sends a ninefold thunder tribulation; failing it scatters his soul.

a_genre_1.literal: Classic karmic reckoning from the heavens: fail the nine-layered thunder tribulation and the soul scatters.
a_genre_1.plain: Heaven's law brought this on; fail the ninefold lightning trial and the soul is destroyed.
a_genre_1.genre: Heavenly Dao's reckoning: fail the Ninefold Thunder Tribulation and your soul scatters.

a_genre_2.literal: Heaven's karma; a nine-layer lightning tribulation; fail and your soul flies apart and scatters.
a_genre_2.plain: It's heaven's law. Fail the ninefold trial by lightning and your soul gets destroyed.

a_genre_3.literal: The heavens demand it; if you can't withstand the thunder tribulation, your soul is scattered.
